objective: Produce a finished five-experiment portfolio study of synthetic intervention choice and regret before deciding whether additional corpus construction is worthwhile.
required_before_any_reveal: all five local recommendations exist and verify against their raw-output, task, bundle, split, and scope hashes
the zero-cost run has zero unreported parse failures
a separate explicit development-reveal decision is recorded
the five revealed experiments are permanently labelled development rather than untouched canonical test
portfolio_claim_boundary: The five-task pilot may establish pipeline behavior and concrete decision successes or failures on these tasks. It cannot validate a general trust model or broad cross-paradigm reliability.
expansion_gate: Decide whether to run all eleven contracts or audit another corpus only after the five-task development results are available and the incremental value is explicit.
